name: Fernando Castro
summary: Fernando Castro has 2 coaching stints at 2 clubs (33 league games) in the dataset, from 2007/08 to 2009/10. Too few games for a grade (the ranking requires at least 3 stints and 10 games). The best stint above squad-value expectation was Polideportivo Ejido 2007/08 (-0.16 PPG); the toughest was Leixões SC 2009/10 (-0.54 PPG).
